messages:
Ellen P: urgent @eng-security: CVE-2026-0891 (libfastcrypto) just dropped. Upstream says remote signing vulnerability affects versions <2.4.1. We use libfastcrypto in token-service and model-cache. Immediate patch + key rotation required.

security-oncall: automated scanner flagged token-service binary built with libfastcrypto 2.3.9. We generated SEC-7609 and DM'd owners. No external indicators yet, but assume compromise possible for tokens signed with affected libs.

Tom H: Are container images affected or only the runtime libs? Do we need to stop traffic?

Ellen P: Both. Containers embed the vulnerable lib in the runtime image. Recommend: 1) deploy patched image 2.4.1+ 2) rotate signing keys used for short-lived tokens 3) invalidate outstanding sessions/tokens older than 1h.

Jae K: Quick remediation steps for infra teams:
```
# build patched image
docker build -t gcr.io/redwood/token-service:2.4.1 --build-arg FASTCRYPTO_VER=2.4.1 .
# push and promote to staging
gcloud builds submit --tag gcr.io/redwood/token-service:2.4.1
# rotate signing key
vault write transit/keys/token-signing/rotate
# bump token version to force reissue
```

infra-qa: We'll block rollout to production until smoke tests pass in staging. We can apply a temporary WAF rule to throttle token endpoints if needed.

security-oncall: Checklist: 1) patch and deploy patched images to staging within 2 hours 2) rotate signing keys and publish new public keys to jwks endpoint 3) set token TTL to 5m temporarily and enforce re-auth for existing sessions 4) run token-verify-scan across services and report counts 5) confirm completion in this thread with evidence.

release-coord: Scheduling hotfix window: staging at 22:00 UTC, prod at 23:30 UTC with canary traffic for 15m. Teams owning token-service, model-cache, and auth-proxy please be ready.

Tom H: Started build now. Pushing patched image. Will follow the rotation playbook and update Vault.

Ellen P: Also note: audit logs show token-service issued ~120k tokens in last 24h. We'll invalidate tokens issued before rollout by bumping token schema version in auth-proxy. Expect some user sessions to require re-login. Communicate to support.

infra-qa: Staging smoke tests passed. Patched images promoted to canary.

security-oncall: Rotated signing key and published new JWKS. Run token-verify-scan: found 2 services still using old library in experimental tags. Owners notified via DM.

Jae K: I've issued org-wide advisory draft for support and product to post a short user-facing note. Also adding policy: require dependency scanning gating for critical crypto libs.

Ellen P: Confirming prod deploy complete, canary healthy. Rotation done. We will run a follow-up audit and produce a short postmortem tomorrow. Thanks all.

security-oncall: Closing SEC-7609 pending postmortem. If teams find any anomalous token usage, reopen and tag this thread.
